training_latent_states: All binary triples except 111; true outputs are (a,b,c) or (a,b XOR c,c). Input and output channel permutations are hidden from learned arms.
evaluation: Frozen memory and route errors. ID uses fresh draws, shift reverses nuisance correlation, novel uses excluded 111, interventions pair a fresh state with a single latent-bit flip and fixed nuisances. Evaluation seeds are training seed + 100000 + split index.
selection: Three distinct candidate routes selected greedily by local prequential squared error plus key width cost; output and input overlap penalties use only currently selected routes. Conflicting duplicate output predictions abstain; missing outputs abstain.
stop_rule: Run this version once and retain all negative gates. Do not tune on evaluation or claim learned overlap specialization unless all registered gates pass in every seed/task.
scope: Bounded supervised selection of anonymous one/two-channel routes, with supplied input channels and labeled output slots. No learned encoder, anonymous concept emergence, structural growth, spiking advantage, real data or runtime promotion.
